Take the %1$s we discussed earlier in this conversation and give it to me as a CSV file, in exactly the format below.

Format (keep the header row and the column names exactly as shown):

%2$s

Rules:
%3$s

How to answer:
- Use the details we agreed on in our conversation. If something we didn't settle is needed (for example sets, reps or macros), choose a sensible value instead of asking me.
- Put the whole CSV in one code block so I can copy it, or attach it as a .csv file if you can.
- Reply with only the CSV: no explanations, no extra columns, no blank rows.

I tried to import a CSV file as %1$s into my workout app and it failed with these errors:
%2$s
Please fix the CSV and send the whole corrected file again, in exactly this format:

%3$s

Rules:
%4$s

- One row per exercise. Rows of the same day go together, in training order; the first exercise of a day is its main lift.
- day: name of the workout day (max %1$d characters).
- sets: 1-%2$d. rep_min and rep_max: the target rep range (for type "minutes" it is minutes).
- type: "reps" for weight x reps, "minutes" for cardio.
- stat: STR (upper body), CON (legs), STA (cardio).
- increment_kg: weight added when every set reaches rep_max (2.5 usually, 5 for big lower-body lifts, 0 for cardio).
- Each exercise at most once per day.
- superset: optional, usually empty. To do exercises as a superset (alternating one set of each), give them the same label (A, B, …). A superset's rows must be next to each other in the same day, and it needs at least 2 exercises.

- One row per exercise, in training order.
- sets: 1-%1$d. rep_min and rep_max: the target rep range (for type "minutes" it is minutes).
- type: "reps" for weight x reps, "minutes" for cardio.
- stat: STR (upper body), CON (legs), STA (cardio).
- increment_kg: weight added when every set reaches rep_max (2.5 usually, 5 for big lower-body lifts, 0 for cardio).
- Each exercise at most once.
- superset: optional, usually empty. To do exercises as a superset (alternating one set of each), give them the same label (A, B, …). A superset's rows must be next to each other, and it needs at least 2 exercises.

- One row per meal (max %1$d characters in the name).
- protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g: grams for ONE portion, numbers only (0-1000).
- kcal: calories for one portion; leave empty to calculate it from the macros.
- tags: optional, separated by | (for example breakfast|high-protein).
- recipe_url and recipe: optional. Put text containing commas in double quotes.

- One row per meal of the day, in eating order (max %1$d rows).
- slot: name of the slot (Breakfast, Lunch, ...). time: 24-hour HH:mm, optional.
- protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, fiber_g: grams for ONE portion, numbers only (0-1000).
- kcal: calories for one portion; leave empty to calculate it from the macros.
- tags: optional, separated by | (for example breakfast|high-protein).
- The plan's daily targets are the sum of its meals.
